mapper.sql: id, course_name, course_days, teaching_mode, material_path, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select:
select from sys_course
and (course_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or material_path like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_course(course_name, course_days, teaching_mode, material_path, created_at, updated_at) values(#{courseName}, #{courseDays}, #{teachingMode}, #{materialPath}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select count(*) from sys_class where course_id = #{courseId}
